g.text: Reviewed flags where they exist, production flags where they do not

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Panel a counts each arm's own final reference ledger — the single agent's q3_references.jsonl per run and the June per-target arm's References JSONL per report. It is the one panel that

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: depends on no flag, aggregation or provenance choice. The single agent collects 4 references on 1 target and 11 on 893 — a flat 3–19 across all 24 runs, so it does a

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: fixed amount of final-reference output whatever the workload; the per-target arm reaches 7,586, about 8.5 per target.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781
font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Panels b and c: the per-target arm takes the best provenance available per pair — the 260801 union primary atlas wherever it placed a call (citation-reviewed, stage-2

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: with full reference ledgers), the 260713 production corpus's own `lit_direction` only where the atlas is silent. Precedence is by pair, so no pair blends the two

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: vocabularies. That reaches 2,236 of 2,324 pairs (96.2%) and all 893 targets, against 1,249 pairs (53.7%) and 373 targets for the atlas alone. At 893: 1,640 grounded pair calls vs 82,

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: grounded share 73% vs 4%. The 'reviewed' column in c is the share of that rung's pairs carrying reviewed flags. The fill is not neutral: the reviewed layer

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: runs 32.6% Agree / 4.0% Disagree and the fill layer 9.2% / 23.0%, because stage-2 review demotes most self-reported disagreements — so combined Disagree (12%)

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: sits between the two. Grounded share barely differs between layers (72.7% vs 74.1%), so the fill changes which grounded flag a pair carries, not whether it is grounded. 88

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: pairs are covered by neither corpus. Fractional aggregation; seeds as light marks.
